# Your status page should not go down with your app.

> A free, self-hosted status page with uptime monitoring, 90-day bars, incidents, maintenance windows and alerts. An open-source alternative to Statuspage, Instatus and Better Stack. MIT, zero dependencies.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
